source_atoms.finding: The file-level contract declares hard per-hook time budgets, a SIGALRM upper bound, fail-silent behavior and an unconditional no-LLM-in-hook rule.

Defaults make Stop a 2.0s hook, enable kognition by default, use local qwen2.5:0.5b and give the synchronous model call a 1.3s timeout. The comments explicitly intend the model timeout to leave room for later Stop work.
_HookTimeout subclasses Exception; the SIGALRM handler raises _HookTimeout; cmd_hook installs ITIMER_REAL for the whole hook and expects the outer except _HookTimeout boundary to abort the event.

_ollama_generate wraps the blocking urllib Ollama call in operational error handling followed by a broad except Exception that logs and returns None. Because _HookTimeout is an Exception, a SIGALRM delivered while execution is inside this try can be consumed at this nested boundary instead of reaching cmd_hook's outer timeout handler.

The Stop path performs model relevance judging before gw_absicht bookkeeping, governance-turn accounting and waiting-status update. Therefore swallowing the global timeout inside cognition can permit execution to return to later Stop tail work instead of source-enforcing immediate global-deadline abort.

cmd_hook separately handles _HookTimeout only at its outer boundary, logs timeout, disarms the timer in cleanup, logs total duration and returns 0. The source does not provide a typed receipt proving which Stop substeps completed when a nested handler consumes the timeout signal.
